scope.summary: Unifies the operator dashboard's neutral visual language, semantic information feedback, and explicit destructive action hierarchy without changing its guarded workflows.
out_of_scope: Any Orrery, Three.js, WebGL, or other 3D surface

entry_points.name: dashboard type, production build, and regression suite
entry_points.trace: `cd web && npm run check` exited 0 at source 6591a390: TypeScript, Vite production build, SBOM and bundle checks, and 236 dashboard tests passed; 7 existing served-console tests remained intentionally skipped.

entry_points.name: visual semantic action regression
entry_points.trace: `cd web && npm exec vitest run src/app/wig-polish.test.tsx src/app/conformance.test.tsx` exited 0 with 24 tests. It proves routine primary confirmation remains gold, destructive confirmation uses the rust danger variant with a visible focus ring, information uses its separate semantic token, and the information-token contrast remains at least 3:1.

entry_points.name: browser operator workflow regression
entry_points.trace: `cd web && npm exec playwright test e2e/ux-shell.spec.ts e2e/ux-audit-layout.spec.ts e2e/ux-recovery.spec.ts e2e/ux-explorer-selection.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts` exited 0 with 9 Chromium tests. It preserves keyboard navigation, narrow viewport behavior, error recovery, audit layout, and Explorer selection lifecycle.

limitations: This is local dashboard and browser coverage with stubbed operator responses; it does not claim a live Oracle-backed run.
No fuzzing or mutation campaign was run.
